name: Pydantic
description: Data validation using Python type hints.
summary: Pydantic welcomes AI use in contributions, but contributors must certify they fully understand the code they submit. AI-generated pull request descriptions are allowed, though incoherent or nonsensical ones may be closed and can lead to a ban.

evidence.quote: We welcome the use of AI when contributing to Pydantic. However, users should certify that they fully understand the code being submitted.
* the pull request description is AI generated *and* incoherent or nonsensical.
Such behavior can also result in a permanent ban from the organization.
